title: 第17章 苍炎灵果第18章 提取奖励引动天劫
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
“萧兄误会，林某并不知那是有主之地，但也只是刚到......”
“那就是有了？”
人皮面具下，方玉凝强忍笑意，根本不给林尘说完话的机会。
当即打断，同时提剑便朝林尘刺去。
当然，
她倒也不能提剑真砍，所以一招一式都有放慢。
让你小子不打招呼偷偷乱跑！
害得小爷我浪费三张神行符！
......
方玉凝虽然招招留手，但五品灵兵上的寒气却是不容小觑。
每次闪身躲过，林尘衣衫上，都会凝结一层寒霜。
“萧兄，一切都是误会，我并没有踏足幻阵，也并不知道里面到底有什么。”
虽然察觉剑招有意放慢，但林尘只觉是眼前青年是在戏耍于他，不禁有些气愤。
眼前这人实力雄厚，不可硬拼！
心中思索着，林尘再次侧身闪开一剑，尝试跟赤云老鬼沟通。
“云老，刚刚的秘术可还能施展？”
“云老？”
林尘一遍遍地呼唤，心中焦急万分。
而此时此刻，回归铜鼎的赤云老鬼，在听到林尘的呼喊后。
立马再次换了个方向，继续休养生息。

他又不是傻子。
小两口打情骂俏，他去凑什么热闹。
当paly的一环吗？
虽然容貌和修为，都演饰极好。
但那白玉簪中的异火气息，他却无比熟悉。
每一道异火所散发的气息，都是世间独一无二，且不可复制的。
同样一种异火，实际上有很多不同之处。
当然，这些东西，只凭看是看不出来的。
等到外面没什么动静了，赤云老鬼立刻舒舒服服的翻了个身。
器灵，也是要休息的......
叫天叫不应，叫地地不灵。
看着凌厉剑锋再次刺来，这次林尘没有躲闪，反而迎难直上。
双手合掌接住剑刃，他下意识，准备拉近距离，握拳反击。
可还未等想法落实，他便身形暴退数十步，不断对着双手哈气揉搓。
好厉害的寒气！
刚刚只是碰了一下，林尘便感觉那寒意刺骨，直锥人心。
被寒气裹挟着，双手不断发麻。
好一阵儿，才缓过劲来。
而在此期间，方玉凝也只是静静的看着。
一连数十剑，戳得林尘衣衫破烂。

若原本只是贫困，现在足以称得上是乞丐。
content_en:
"Brother Xiao misunderstood. Lin didn't know that it was an owned land, but he had just arrived..."
"That's it?"
Under the human skin mask, Fang Yuning suppressed a smile and did not give Lin Chen a chance to finish his words.
He immediately interrupted and at the same time raised his sword and stabbed Lin Chen.
Of course,
She couldn't lift the sword to actually strike, so every move was slowed down.
Let your kid run around without saying hello!
I made you waste three magical talismans!
...
Although Fang Yuning held back her skills, the coldness on the fifth-grade spiritual soldiers should not be underestimated.
Every time he dodged, a layer of frost would condense on Lin Chen's clothes.
"Brother Xiao, everything is a misunderstanding. I have not set foot in the illusion formation, and I don't know what is inside."
Although he noticed that the sword moves were deliberately slowed down, Lin Chen felt that the young man in front of him was playing tricks on him, and he couldn't help but feel a little angry.
The person in front of you is very powerful and cannot be fought forcefully!
Thinking in his mind, Lin Chen sideways dodged the sword again and tried to communicate with Old Ghost Chiyun.
"Mr. Yun, can you still use the secret technique just now?"
"Lao Yun?"
Lin Chen called over and over again, feeling very anxious in his heart.
At this moment, the old ghost Chiyun who returned to Tongding heard Lin Chen's cry.
He immediately changed direction again and continued to recuperate.
He's not a fool.
The young couple were flirting and he was there to join in the fun.
Be part of the paly?
Although the appearance and cultivation are excellent, the acting is excellent.
But he was extremely familiar with the strange fire aura in the white jade hosta.
The aura emitted by each strange fire is unique in the world and cannot be copied.
The same alien fire actually has many differences.
Of course, these things cannot be seen just by looking.
When there was no movement outside, Old Ghost Chiyun immediately turned over comfortably.
The weapon spirit also needs to rest...
Calls to the heavens do not respond, calls to the earth and the earth do not work.
Watching the sharp sword strike strike again, Lin Chen did not dodge this time, but faced the challenge head on.
Putting his hands together to catch the sword, he subconsciously prepared to close the distance and clenched his fists to counterattack.
But before the idea could be realized, he took dozens of steps back and kept exhaling and rubbing his hands.
What a severe cold!
Just after touching it, Lin Chen felt a bone-chilling chill that hit his heart.
Wrapped in the cold air, his hands continued to feel numb.
It took a while to calm down.
During this period, Fang Yuning just watched quietly.
Dozens of swords struck Lin Chen's clothes in tatters.
If he was just poor originally, he is now enough to be called a beggar.
